mentions.name: Even Keel
mentions.description: An agent-orchestration application that takes tickets from trackers (GitHub, Linear, and Huly in v0.1.4) and hands each one to an AI agent (Claude or Codex via subscriptions/API keys), starting an agent for every issue and working task by task, one at a time per folder. It includes a parallel mode for running more than one project at a time, and v0.2 is planned with more supported trackers, agents, and features.
mentions.source_excerpt: For now Im working on an agent-orchestration application that is taking tickets from a tracker and giving them to an Agent. It's called Even Keel.
